title.narrative: Advancing PFM Reforms for SDGs Achievement in Kyrgyzstan

description.narrative: The project Advancing Public Finance Management Reforms for Sustainable Development Goals Achievement in Kyrgyzstan funded by the European Union (EU) seeks to contribute to enhance effectiveness and inclusivity of Kyrgyz Republic’s Public Finance Management (PFM) system. Through the proposed interventions, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP) aims to leverage its comparative advantages and provide support to the further development of the institutional environment of the PFM system in the Kyrgyz Republic which is broadly well-functioning. The proposed project builds on the past successes of the UNDP programmatic activities related to PFM including partnerships with state bodies and civil society.The project aims at strengthening PFM system in Kyrgyzstan by providing technical assistance to the Ministry of Finance or other agencies and by supporting the scaling-up of the previous efforts of the UNDP and other development partners in PFM. These efforts have established a well-functioning PFM system and form strong basis for further improvements and development.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).

The Implementing Partner shall ensure that all of its obligations set forth under the section entitled “Legal Context and/or Risk Management Standard Clauses” are passed on to each responsible party, subcontractor and sub-recipient and that all the clauses under this section entitled “Risk Management” are included, mutatis mutandis, in all sub-contracts or sub-agreements entered into further to the Project Document
